title: Le Colisée — l'Arène du Destin d'Arenarea, version finale (LOT-09)
locationExcerpt: Famed for the Arena of Fate, where combat and politics shape the empire, the district caters to elite nobles and officials with upscale shops and homes.
This district is a nexus for political intrigue, with decisions sealed in the Arena either by the battles or whispered conversations.
subject: the Arena of Fate itself, and nothing of the district around it: a grand noble arena of marble and stone where combat and politics meet, with sand, tiered stands, noble boxes, vaulted corridors under the stands and locker rooms for the fighters
